activity_summary: You played the Knave in the afternoon. Cowley came through the dry place once and apologised to nobody. Your eight lines held. Heminges would not call the play mended. Pope would not call once a triumph. You said you were not proud of the eight, and that Kemp has not been shown the king.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Said the eight lines held, and that he was not proud of them.

entities.name: Richard Cowley
entities.context: Came through the dry place once and apologised to nobody.

entities.name: John Heminges
entities.context: Refused to call the afternoon a mending, and would not shut a bag on it.

entities.name: Thomas Pope
entities.context: Counted once against Tuesday's four, and would not add them into a new play.

entities.name: John Sincler
entities.context: Had a doublet that met, and would not call that a victory.

entities.name: the old Knave
entities.context: Mentioned in Through the dry place once

facets.activity: Played the Knave, and Cowley came through the dry place once

quotes.speaker: richard_cowley
quotes.text: I came through the dry place once.

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: The eight lines held. I am not proud of them.
